fusions.name: Barbed Parting
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Flings a barbed sting at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Barb Squall
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stings on the breeze, spread apart, each of which deals 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. [Poisoned] is catching: it passes to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Foragers Aloft
fusions.desc: Sends out a swarm for 12 seconds that stings an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second, each sting with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Out of Breath
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, you regain 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
